description: Estimate a pregnancy due date and current stage using Naegele's rule, from the last menstrual period (LMP), conception date, or an IVF embryo-transfer date. Returns the estimated due date, weeks pregnant now, trimester and weeks remaining. Informational only, not medical advice.

asOf.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for "weeks pregnant now" (default today).

date.description: The relevant date as YYYY-MM-DD: LMP, conception, or IVF transfer date.

embryoAge.description: Embryo age in days at IVF transfer (commonly 3 or 5; default 5).

name: calculate_due_date
